summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing for Kedbyte marketing site. 6/6 pytest tests pass and all critical UI flows (navigation, accordion, contact form, mobile menu) work end-to-end. Found and fixed one MongoDB _id leak in GET /api/contacts response. UI submission successfully persists to MongoDB and email_sent=false (expected since Resend not configured).

minor.issue: Was returning MongoDB _id field instead of id (ObjectId leak). FIXED by adding response_model_by_alias=False to the route.

issues: Console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' Cosmetic only — does not affect functionality. Consider adding position:relative to the scroll container (body or .App) to silence the warning.

action_items: (Optional) Add position:relative to App/scroll container to remove Lenis console warning.
(Future) Configure RESEND_API_KEY in backend/.env so contact emails are actually delivered (currently email_sent=false which is expected per request).
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: GET /api/contacts was leaking MongoDB _id in response (violates the 'never expose ObjectId' rule). Patched server.py with response_model_by_alias=False.
Contact model uses created_at as ISO string field default-factory'd at construction time. This is fine but consider switching to datetime field if you need date range filtering later.
POST /api/contact returns success even if Resend API call fails (email_id=None). Good UX — failure is logged but user still gets confirmation that submission was stored. Acceptable for current MVP.
All required data-testids are in place across pages, header, mobile menu, careers accordion, and contact form. Excellent testability.
No auth, no rate limiting on /api/contact — fine for MVP but consider basic rate-limiting (e.g. slowapi) before production to prevent abuse.
seed_data_creation: Test runs insert TEST_-prefixed contact submissions into the 'contacts' collection. Easy to identify and clean up later if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_contact_api.py is the regression suite. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Frontend flows verified via Playwright: nav links, mobile menu, careers accordion (role-toggle-0..4 + role-apply-0..4 → /contact), contact form validation toast on empty submit, success toast + form reset + DB persistence on valid submit. The MongoDB _id leak fix in server.py should remain. Email sending intentionally disabled (no Resend key) — do not flag email_sent=false as a bug.
